integrity: Every listed exact polynomial and root interval is recomputed from the sixteen fully specified local maps. Complement conjugacy supplies the remaining sixteen maps. Bounded independent finite-word tests do not by themselves prove the infinite claim; the proof uses labeled finite-state path growth and Perron–Frobenius theory.
scientific_limitations: One-step spatial image on the bilateral full binary shift only; no classification of iterates, temporal entropy, or limit sets. Exact finite computation uses Python 3 and SymPy. Prior art may contain unindexed equivalent entropy tables.
title: Seven one-step image-entropy levels for binary radius-two lazy cellular automata
